about.heading: About me
about.lead: I build software people enjoy using. I explain the process in plain language and partner with product teams to turn tricky problems into simple, human-friendly products.
about.paragraph: I help deliver great UX, production-ready code, and DevOps that scales with your ambitions. I'm always learning and excited by interesting challenges — if you'd like someone who gets things done without the jargon, let's talk.
about.howIHelpParagraph: From sketch to scale: I connect good architecture with dependable delivery so businesses can move confidently.
about.howIHelpList1: Frontends that feel snappy and are easy to maintain (Angular, Vite, Tailwind).
about.howIHelpList2: APIs and integrations built for reliability and clarity (Java, .NET, Python).
about.howIHelpList3: Repeatable release pipelines and infra-as-code using Kubernetes and Azure DevOps.
about.waysOfWorkingParagraph: Scrum‑savvy full‑stack developer who builds products tailored to your needs. I use practical rhythms where they help, then focus on delivering the right outcomes — not selling process, shipping product.
about.waysOfWorkingList1: Product-first delivery: align roadmap and work to measurable outcomes.
about.waysOfWorkingList2: Hands-on development across frontend and backend.
about.waysOfWorkingList3: Pairing, code reviews, and a quality-first engineering mindset.

services.heading: Your company in focus
services.intro: Whether you need a new website, want to automate your business, or are looking for expert advice, I help small businesses grow with modern, reliable technology. Let's find the right solution for your goals and budget.
services.webPlatformsList1: Launch a website that works for you: attract new customers, showcase your business, and update your content easily—no tech skills needed.
services.webPlatformsList2: Get analytics to understand your visitors and localization to reach more people.
services.webPlatformsList3: Design systems that keep your site looking sharp and consistent.
services.webPlatformsList4: Built with fast, modern tools for top performance.
services.productAppsList1: Automate your daily tasks and connect your favorite tools—save time and reduce errors.
services.productAppsList2: Custom portals and workflows tailored to your business needs.
services.productAppsList3: Reliable APIs and integrations so everything works together seamlessly.
services.productAppsList4: Preview changes safely before they go live.
services.automationList1: Keep your business running smoothly and securely with expert automation.
services.automationList2: Monitor your systems with clear dashboards and alerts.
services.automationList3: Get help setting up cloud, backups, and security—no more tech headaches.
services.automationList4: Proven solutions for peace of mind.
services.footerText: Send over your deck or backlog—we'll co-create a plan within 48 hours.
